cold_email.subject: Interest in Full-Time Educator / Pocono Premium Outlet (contract to Aug. 2027) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Full-Time Educator / Pocono Premium Outlet (contract to Aug. 2027) opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in PS Research Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear University of Utah Health Research Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the PS Research Associate opportunity with University of Utah Health Research at University of Utah Health Research.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator opportunity with UCSF Health at UCSF Health.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Development Specialist, Cockrell School of Engineering — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear The University of Texas at Austin Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Development Specialist, Cockrell School of Engineering opportunity with The University of Texas at Austin at The University of Texas at Austin.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Temporary Research Assistant — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Rutgers University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Temporary Research Assistant opportunity with Rutgers University at Rutgers University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

Dear Plasmidsaurus Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the R&D Research Associate opportunity with Plasmidsaurus at Plasmidsaurus.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Coordinator - Clinical Trials - Mineola opportunity with NYU Langone Health at NYU Langone Health.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Administrative Secretary — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Loma Linda University Health Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Administrative Secretary opportunity with Loma Linda University Health at Loma Linda University Health.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research & Development Lab Technician — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear IXS Coatings Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research & Development Lab Technician opportunity with IXS Coatings at IXS Coatings.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Entry Level - Dental Lab Technician — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Great Lakes Dental Technologies Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Entry Level - Dental Lab Technician opportunity with Great Lakes Dental Technologies at Great Lakes Dental Technologies.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Academic Assistant / Elementary School — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Elevate Charter Schools Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Academic Assistant / Elementary School opportunity with Elevate Charter Schools at Elevate Charter Schools.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Associate I - Levy Lab - Digital Pathology opportunity with Cedars-Sinai at Cedars-Sinai.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in 2026-27 AY Lecturer Pool - Biological Sciences — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear California State University-Sacramento Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the 2026-27 AY Lecturer Pool - Biological Sciences opportunity with California State University-Sacramento at California State University-Sacramento.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Unit Secretary - Per Diem — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Unit Secretary - Per Diem opportunity with Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation at Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in ELOP Leader (TLC after school care) Rancho Canada Elementary 3.75 hrs/day - 2:15 pm - 6:00 pm — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Saddleback Valley Unified School District Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the ELOP Leader (TLC after school care) Rancho Canada Elementary 3.75 hrs/day - 2:15 pm - 6:00 pm opportunity with Saddleback Valley Unified School District at Saddleback Valley Unified School District.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Embedded Lab Technician — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Intellectt Inc Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Embedded Lab Technician opportunity with Intellectt Inc at Intellectt Inc.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Community Development Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear 18Birdies Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Community Development Coordinator opportunity with 18Birdies at 18Birdies.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - 001227 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 001227 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - Full Time — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - Full Time opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Accounting Analytics & BI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you'll play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial AI by establishing the analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities our Accounting organization runs on. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. You'll partner closely with the Accounting organization to build the data foundation that turns financial and operational data into reliable, self-serve insight and automated processes. That means owning the data models and orchestration beneath accounting analytics, designing the dashboards and data applications stakeholders rely on day to day, and partnering across Data Engineering, Data Science, and the broader Finance organization to make sure every number is one the team can trust. Increasingly, it also means defining the future of AI-powered accounting automation; finding where AI can take on work that is manual today and reshape how the function operates. This is a foundational, hands-on role at the intersection of accounting, analytics, and business intelligence. You'll establish the durable, scalable systems the fast-growing function depends on, bringing the rigor of a culture of excellence to a function still being built from the ground up, and taking projects end to end, from an ambiguous question to a trusted, scalable system. Key responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data models and orchestration pipelines (dbt, Airflow) that power analytics, reporting, and downstream financial workflows Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data applications that give stakeholders self-serve access to their data Translate stakeholders' business questions into well-defined metrics and tools, and turn the resulting analysis into clear recommendations Build analytics that support financial reporting, the close process, reconciliations, and scenario analysis Define the future of AI-powered accounting automation in partnership with stakeholders, streamlining workflows and reducing manual effort Champion data quality, testing, and documentation across the data stack Minimum qualifications Proficiency in SQL and Python (or another object-oriented programming language) Experience with data modeling and orchestration tools (e.g., dbt and Airflow) Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, Streamlit) Experience designing self-serve analytics experiences for non-technical stakeholders A track record of partnering closely with Finance or Accounting teams to drive business and financial outcomes, turning open questions and data into clear, insightful analysis Preferred qualifications Experience using AI to improve or automate analytical processes Experience building data applications Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and their cost structures Experience modeling financial impact, including forecasting and scenario analysis A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of effective A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress A deep curiosity and energy for pulling the thread on hard questions A passion for Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $345,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood's International team owns the full international product experience, bringing investing, trading, and crypto to customers in the EU, UK, Canada, Singapore, and beyond. As a Product Designer, you'll help shape how customers around the world experience our products for the first time. You'll design onboarding, trading, and money movement experiences that hold up across currencies, languages, and regulatory environments, while staying true to the craft and clarity Robinhood is known for. Design at Robinhood is AI-first. This role is for someone who already uses AI as a core part of how they think, explore, and execute. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Design end-to-end experiences for onboarding, identity verification, trading, crypto and money movement in international markets. Deliverables include user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, interaction specifications and high-fidelity designs. Apply cognitive psychology and human factors principles to high-stakes flows such as a first deposit or first trade, including trust formation, risk perception, decision-making under uncertainty, cognitive load and mental models. Plan and run usability studies, diary studies and behavioral experiments, such as moderated testing, interviews, surveys and A/B tests. Turn the findings into design decisions and document the evidence. Work with product, engineering, legal, compliance and security to translate market-specific regulatory requirements into clear, usable interface designs. Simplify cross-border and multi-currency concepts (FX, fees, settlement) through interface design, information hierarchy and content design. Localize and adapt experiences so they feel native to each market. Build and maintain design system components that balance global consistency with local needs, informed by research on cultural differences in attitudes toward money, risk and trust. Design accessible experiences that meet WCAG standards, including for users in sensitive or high-stakes situations. Use AI tools to explore concepts, catch edge cases and prototype faster. You own quality and direction, and you review AI output for user bias, confusion and emotional impact. Define design direction in markets with little precedent using hypothesis-driven design: frame the question, test it with users, and let the findings guide the work. Own the design of products from concept through launch, defining form, function, usability and interaction behavior. Produce design specifications and work with engineers through implementation, reviewing builds for fidelity, performance and usability. Balance usability, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements and business constraints in design decisions. Apply human factors principles, including usability, safety and error prevention, to reduce user mistakes in high-stakes flows. Design across web, iOS and Android, adapting interactions to each device's capabilities and input methods (touch, haptics, biometrics). Build prototypes at multiple fidelities and test them against usability criteria before launch. What you bring A bachelor's degree in psychology, cognitive science or a closely related behavioral science. This knowledge is a core requirement of the role, because our design decisions rest on how people perceive risk, form trust and make decisions. 2+ years of product design experience, including internships and co-ops. A portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of shipped digital product design, from research-informed problem framing through prototyping, usability testing and final design, with outcomes tied to user behavior. Hands-on research experience in academic or applied settings, including research methods and basic statistics applied to usability studies and experiments. Knowledge of cognitive psychology and human factors, including cognitive load, decision-making and cross-cultural differences. Familiarity with research ethics, informed consent and participant protection. Experience working with legal, compliance and cross-functional partners in a regulated environment, ideally expanding products across markets. Experience with design systems and accessibility. Regular use of AI in your design process, with the judgment to review its output critically. Strong systems thinking, with the ability to decide what stays consistent across markets and what should flex. A bias for action: you find the next step through ambiguity and learn through fast, small studies. Experience handing off design specifications to engineering and reviewing implementation. Experience designing for multiple platforms and device types. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $140,000 — $165,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $123,000 — $145,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $110,000 — $129,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Application Limit: Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications in any 90 days. Within that time, they may apply to each role only once. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical lab Associate I — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical lab Associate I opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Phlebotomist Test Coordinator - Maywood, IL
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Natera Test Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless testing experience for patients. This position is responsible for scheduling and determining the most effective method for blood collection, preparing specimens for laboratory testing, and managing all necessary paperwork to ensure compliance. In this role, you will work closely with customers and the sales team to facilitate an efficient ordering process and timely reporting of results. The ideal candidate thrives in an independent work environment, excels at multitasking, and demonstrates strong critical thinking skills to resolve issues promptly. This is a clinic based position in Maywood, IL Job offer is contingent upon pre-employment requirements for the assigned clinic. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES PHLEBOTOMY SERVICES: Perform venipunctures to obtain blood specimens with precision and care. Verify patient identity and test requisitions, ensuring accuracy by cross-referencing EMR records and resolving discrepancies. Maintain specimen integrity by following aseptic techniques, department protocols, and isolation procedures. Accurately track collected specimens by documenting initials, date, and collection time, while maintaining daily collection logs. PATIENT CARE COORDINATION: Oversee and coordinate patient care services to ensure efficient and high-quality healthcare delivery. Manage administrative tasks, including accessing patient records, scheduling appointments, and aligning blood draw times with clinic requirements. Collaborate with Field Sales and internal operations teams to provide patient support and ensure continuity of care. Develop and maintain strong patient relationships to encourage ongoing testing and adherence to recommended care plans. ADMINISTRATIVE AND OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT: Act as the primary liaison for accounts and Sales, documenting all interactions, communications, and follow-ups. Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries, ensuring timely issue resolution. Build rapport with patients, accounts, and Sales teams to resolve missing information and maintain turnaround time (TAT) expectations. Proactively communicate delays and cancellations, facilitating timely sample redraws when necessary. Investigate and resolve escalated issues, providing clear and logical explanations of root causes and resolutions through phone and electronic communications . QUALITY ASSURANCE AND COMPLIANCE: Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by adhering to CAP CLIA standards, legal regulations, and organizational policies. Maintain high-quality results by following department protocols, testing schedules, and recording outcomes in quality control logs. Monitor and report process improvement needs to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, as well as internal operational guidelines. QUALIFICATIONS Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of phlebotomy experience; oncology experience required. Education: BS/BA degree (preferred); High School Diploma (or equivalent) required. Certification: Phlebotomy Certificate (as required by state regulations). EMPLOYMENT AND COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all pre-employment and clinic-specific compliance requirements, which may include, but are not limited to: Criminal background screening and employment verification Drug and alcohol screening Verification of licensure, certifications, and clinical competencies Immunization records and/or immunity titers TB testing and respiratory mask fit testing, if required Pre-employment physical examination, if applicable Completion of required compliance, safety, infection prevention, and facility onboarding training Professional references and performance verification Any additional clinic, facility, or regulatory onboarding requirements necessary for patient care access Failure to meet or maintain required compliance standards may impact employment eligibility or assignment placement. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES Serve and protect the Natera clinic community by adhering to professional standards, hospital policies and procedures, federal, state, and local requirements. Strong ability to uphold Natera’s professional standards, policies, and regulatory requirements. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and patients. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT Office-based clinic setting with scrubs required, following safe clinical practices for all blood draws. Must be able to safely lift, carry, and move items weighing up to 50 pounds on a regular basis, Work schedule determined based on clinic requirements. OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. cold_email.subject: Interest in Phlebotomist Test Coordinator - Maywood, IL — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Phlebotomist Test Coordinator - Maywood, IL opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Frontier Academy trains engineers at our customers and partners to build with Claude in production. We are scaling quickly, with multiple cohorts running in parallel across cities. This is the role that keeps all of it on schedule. As Program Manager, you'll own the cohort schedule and the seats, and you'll be the single point of coordination across our delivery partners, forward deployed engineers, the Academy team, and the account and partner managers who nominate participants. Vendors and delivery partners run the rooms. You'll make sure the right people are in the right seats, at the right time, with everything they need. You'll report to the Academy's operating lead. Key responsibilities Own the schedule and seats: run batching, the waitlist, confirmations, and backfills across parallel cohorts; leadership allocates seats, and you execute, including placing Anthropic's own newly hired forward deployed engineers and technical deployment leads Be the counterpart to our delivery and venue partners: sign off on dates, room sizes, and venue holds, and book and backfill Anthropic presenters Be the first stop for the field: answer account and partner managers, move them to self-serve, and support them when results are contested; deal with participating organizations directly only by exception Run readiness and close-out: enforce the IT readiness gate before each cohort, then run badge rosters, residency additions, extensions, and data requests Run the program rhythm: action tracking, steering group inputs, the Academy's internal site, KPI reporting, and following legal, privacy, and IT items through to closure Own data hygiene: keep the program's documents, attendee data, and dashboards compliant and organized, and bring everyone to one right place for program information and communications Pass on what you learn: bring feedback from each run to the Academy and platform teams Build the playbook: templates, trackers, and automations, built with Claude, that make each run take less effort than the last Minimum qualifications Experience in strategy and operations, program operations, or a similar role Experience running recurring cohort or event programs with vendors Experience coordinating across many organizations at once and proactively keeping each one informed Strong organization and close attention to detail, with a record of keeping complex schedules on track Comfort pushing back on account and partner managers, and holding to seat allocations and process A data-driven approach, including building and maintaining your own trackers and dashboards, and careful handling of participant data Ability to work independently, and to fix a process rather than repeat a task Effective use of Claude in your own work, including to automate it Ability to respond calmly when plans change at short notice, such as when a speaker or engineer cancels, the wifi fails, or an organization arrives unprepared Preferred qualifications Experience in operations for training, executive education, or recurring events at a technology company Experience with programs that cross countries and time zones The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $215,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. cold_email.subject: Interest in Forward Deployed Engineer - London — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Cognition Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Forward Deployed Engineer - London opportunity with Cognition at Cognition.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Staff Scientist, R&D
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Staff Scientist will lead and support the development and launch of Companion Diagnostic (CDx) assays within the Women’s Health, Organ transplant and Early Cancer Detection team. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and documenting design control activities while ensuring the strict compliance needed to meet FDA CDx quality standards. As a cross-functional collaborator, you will interface with multiple functional groups to drive project deliverables to completion in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will balance various required activities that may include hands-on laboratory work, data analysis, documentation, and leading technical discussions. Success in this role requires a deep technical foundation in molecular biology, nucleic acid extractions on a variety of specimen types, Sanger sequencing, and NGS, plus a proven track record of development and leadership. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead and manage the development of innovative companion diagnostic assays from optimization to validation and launch Define project goals and plans with input from stakeholders and manage multiple project streams in parallel Thoroughly comprehends the objectives and vision of the work Coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet milestones and collaborate closely with project management, regulatory, quality, automation, bioinformatics, statistics, data science and other teams. Demonstrate thorough knowledge of CLSI guidelines and FDA guidance relevant to molecular CDx assays Ensure robust experimental design and data analysis working in conjunction with cross functional teams. Execute complex laboratory experiments; analyze and interpret results to meet the FDA standards. Be flexible to lead multiple studies and laboratory priorities while maintaining targeted timelines; perform other duties as assigned Author high-quality protocols, technical reports, and study documentation. Document research progress under an Electronic Quality Management System following GMP documentation practices Mentor and guide junior scientists while promoting scientific rigor and best practices Communicate progress regularly to stakeholders, including departmental meetings and senior leadership Contribute to risk management, strategy development, and continuous improvement of scientific workflows Contribute to establishing a new laboratory with necessary instruments and equipment Maintain current status on Natera training requirements EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: PhD. in Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience; OR Master’s degree in the fields above with 8+ years of relevant industry experience QUALIFICATIONS: Hands-on Molecular Biology Experience with expertise in Sanger Sequencing and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows (preferably, Illumina and/or PacBio platforms); DNA/RNA extraction, targeted enrichment, or whole genome library preparation and/or deep expertise with other DNA molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR and multiplex PCR Knowledge of Design Controls, Quality Management Systems (QMS), and regulatory standards (FDA, ISO 13485, CLSI) within GLP/GMP environments is a must Ability to own a study from start to finish including designing experiments, executing in the lab, analyzing data and documenting results. Must be able to perform basic statistical analysis Excellent cross-functional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to present complex technical data clearly to non-technical audiences Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to balance multiple priorities and drive deliverables to completion Proven success in managing collaborative and individual projects and communicating externally Experience authoring study plans, protocols and study reports is highly desired Experience with statistical software (such as JMP) is highly desired and comfortable using and integrating AI tools Prior experience in IVD product development or commercialization is highly preferred Experience in manufacturing, scale up, and Quality Control (QC) is preferred Experience with automated liquid handling platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan) is preferred Proven ability to leverage AI-driven tools to enhance workflows and drive operational productivity is an asset The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Austin, TX $112,600 — $140,800 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: - BBB announcement on job scams - FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Reddit’s Product Adoption team accelerates adoption of priority advertising products and features in partnership with our Global Sales and Product organizations. We help advertisers achieve their business goals while building durable product usage and revenue growth. As a Lower Funnel Product Adoption Strategist, you will turn advertiser and business needs into practical product strategies, adoption programs, and measurable outcomes. You will work across assigned accounts, sales teams, products, and markets. Depending on business priorities and your experience, your focus may include Lower Funnel products (including Conversions, Lead Gen, Shopping/Catalog Sales, and App), Reddit Max , Signals implementation (Pixel and CAPI), and other relevant priority product initiatives. You will combine product expertise, consultative selling, analytical thinking, and program execution. You will engage directly with advertisers and agencies, equip sales teams to scale adoption, and bring structured market feedback to Reddit’s Product and go-to-market partners. MULTIPLE OPENINGS, ONE CORE JD This job description supports multiple Product Adoption Strategist openings across various levels. The interview process will help identify the best-fit product specialty, team and market assignment, and level based on candidate strengths and business needs. Strong lower-funnel advertising experience and fluency are required; deep expertise in every listed product or sub-area is not. Large Customer Solutions Lower Funnel IC — Scaled Programs — Design and scale repeatable lower-funnel programs, tools, and enablement that help LCS teams activate priority products across advertisers. Large Customer Solutions Lower Funnel IC — Verticalized Support — Partner with LCS teams in priority verticals to tailor lower-funnel adoption strategies to advertiser needs and share market insights that can guide action. Expertise in Tech/Telco preferred. Mid-Market Shopping IC — Drive Shopping and Catalog Sales adoption through advertiser activation, sales enablement, and feedback on commerce needs for our Mid-market clients. Mid-Market Lower Funnel IC — Help Mid-Market advertisers adopt and grow lower-funnel products through opportunity identification, activation support, and repeatable sales guidance. What you’ll do: Drive product adoption and business outcomes Build and execute account, vertical, or market strategies that identify the right product opportunities and move advertisers from consideration through activation, sustained use, and growth. Translate advertiser objectives and campaign needs into relevant product recommendations, including the prerequisites, implementation steps, and measures of success. Prioritize opportunities with sales partners using business context, product fit, readiness, and potential impact. Advise advertisers and agencies Lead product conversations with advertisers and agency partners, adapting recommendations to their goals, operating context, and level of product maturity. Support product evaluation, onboarding, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization in partnership with the appropriate Reddit teams. Build trusted relationships and communicate product value, trade-offs, requirements, and results clearly. Scale through sales enablement and programs Equip sales teams with practical product knowledge, playbooks, training, collateral, market insights, and repeatable workflows. Develop or improve scalable adoption programs, tools, and processes that help teams address recurring customer needs efficiently. Share effective practices across Product Adoption and sales teams, and coordinate with third-party partners where relevant. Represent the market and influence product direction Gather and synthesize advertiser, agency, and sales feedback to identify barriers, unmet needs, and opportunities. Communicate actionable insights to Product, Product Marketing, Marketing Science, Strategy & Operations, Enablement, and other partners. Help teams understand product changes, readiness requirements, positioning, and go-to-market implications. Measure, learn, and adapt Define useful adoption and outcome measures with Sales and Strategy & Operations partners; monitor progress and recommend next actions. Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to assess what is working, explain gaps, and improve programs and account strategies. Maintain clear documentation of plans, decisions, risks, and follow-through. How you’ll work: Partner closely with Sales and fellow Product Adoption Strategists, as well as Product, Product Marketing, Strategy & Operations, Marketing Science, Enablement, and other cross-functional teams. Manage multiple priorities with sound judgment, balancing direct advertiser engagement with work that can scale across accounts or teams. Operate effectively in a fast-changing environment, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and following through from recommendation to execution. Basic qualifications Experience in digital advertising and ad technology, with demonstrated experience and fluency in lower-funnel advertising and a working understanding of conversion measurement. Experience driving product adoption, growth, sales strategy, or sales programs. Ability to understand customer goals and translate them into practical product recommendations that support advertiser success. Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas to varied audiences. Sound analytical judgment and comfort in using data and customer evidence to assess progress, identify patterns, and guide decisions. Program or project management skills, including the ability to prioritize concurrent work and coordinate across teams. Ability to collaborate and influence across functions, earn trust, and drive work without relying solely on authority. Adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn evolving advertising products and market needs. Proficient in Google Suite and Salesforce. This individual collaborates with a team of CLSs and laboratory personnel to process samples and perform any troubleshooting as needed. Provides feedback during performance evaluations for team members • Assists manager in initiating and completing CAPAs • Collaborates with Manager to resolve personnel issues • Performs other duties QUALIFICATIONS: • 4+ years of experience as a Medical Technologist or equivalent in a clinical laboratory environment. • A bachelor's, or higher, degree in medical technology or laboratory science or a bachelor’s, or higher, degree in one of the chemical, physical, or biological sciences • Current MT/MDxT/CLS/MB certification from ASCP, AMT or AAB is required •A copy of the degree is required upon time of hire. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: • Excellent interpersonal, communication, computer, troubleshooting, and pipetting skills. • Experience in Molecular Biology. • Excellent oral and written communication skills. • Word processing and data management skills.
